g.text: Each arrow: the links from one module's stocks, flows and auxiliaries
to items of another; its label and width give their number.
Dashed: a single link. Parameters count with the module that reads them.
8 modules, 27 module pairs, 118 links between modules (docs/model/edges.csv).
